$comment: Prompts for every photograph the site expects. scripts/generate-images.mjs reads this file when GEMINI_API_KEY is present; without a key nothing happens and the site runs its dark cinematic fallback. Style lock v2 is prepended to every prompt by the script. Generated files need a human review before launch: check faces, hands, logos and any accidental text in frame.
styleLock: Generate a photograph, not an illustration. Documentary event photography at night, shot on a full-frame mirrorless camera, 35mm lens at f/1.4 (or 85mm f/1.8 for close-ups), ISO 3200, slight natural film grain, honest imperfections (uneven light, slight asymmetry, mild motion softness). Lit by practical warm tungsten work lights and cool moonlight. Low-contrast, lifted indigo shadows, natural skin tones, muted color. Fictional adult people, eyes closed when sleeping. Clean frame with no text, no numbers, no logos, no brand marks.

images.prompt: Wide shot of an open-air stadium at dusk from outside a gate, a long line of people in pajamas carrying pillows, sky fading from burnt amber at the horizon to deep indigo, a pale moon, warm light spilling from the gate.
Aerial drone view at night of a stadium field covered in thousands of neat rows of sleeping mats, soft warm aisle lights, light haze, a few people lying down.
Low-angle view along an aisle of sleeping mats, people in pajamas asleep on both sides, strings of warm lights overhead, shallow depth of field.
Close-up of a sleeping adult's face in profile on a mat, eyes closed, a small heart-rate clip on the ear lobe glowing faintly green, cool moonlight and a warm rim light.
Blue-hour view of the same field, the mats catching the first cool light, mist at ground level, a distant stadium rim.
Sunrise over the stadium field, low sun flaring through haze, long warm light across rows of mats, a few people stretching awake.
A hand holding a phone at night, screen glow lighting the face from below, the screen content out of focus and unreadable.
Flat-lay of folded ordinary pajamas, a pillow and a rolled mat on a wooden floor, warm lamp light from one side.
Macro of a fingertip heart-rate clip glowing softly, very shallow depth of field, dark background.
Silhouette of a referee in a striped shirt standing in a mat aisle holding an air horn, backlit by warm work lights, face not visible.
Product-style macro of a vintage air horn on a dark surface with a hard rim light.
Extreme macro of a feather held above a sleeper's closed eyelashes.
Bacon sizzling in a pan with backlit steam, a steaming coffee cup out of focus behind it.
Wide aerial view of rows of sleeping mats under aisle lights at night, seen from high in the stands.
Candid close view of two friends asleep in ordinary pajamas, one hugging a pillow, faces relaxed and eyes closed.
A referee's hand holding a feather over a sleeping contestant, the contestant's face out of focus.
A large dark stadium screen glowing with abstract green light lines, no text and no numbers, silhouettes of people in front of it.
A squad member walking down a mat aisle, air horn held at their side, backlit by warm work lights.
Steam rising across warm lights at the edge of the field, low and drifting, dark background.
